reuse.why: Changes only the existing isNonWorkingDay, which every holiday check in the tree already goes through.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the MM-DD rule exists once in a small private helper.

placement.why: The rule sits in shared/schedules.ts beside isNonWorkingDay, where holiday handling is defined.

scope.why: One helper, one focused test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Tiny, documented change inside the existing abstraction; easy to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All callers (schedules app, getNextDate, weekend adjustment) use isNonWorkingDay.
